LedgerSyncProgress.description: How far a ledger sync has progressed

fields.name: targets
fields.description: How many times the sync has been given a new root to reach

fields.name: targetSetAt
fields.description: When the current target was set

fields.name: pendingChildHashes
fields.description: How many inner nodes the sync is waiting for the children of

fields.name: pendingContents
fields.description: How many account subtrees the sync is waiting for the accounts of

fields.name: synced
fields.description: Whether the ledger has reached the current target

fields.name: answersAccepted
fields.description: How many answers from peers have added to the ledger or confirmed part of it

fields.name: answersIgnored
fields.description: How many answers have arrived for queries the sync no longer needed, such as those for an earlier target

fields.name: answersRejected
fields.description: How many answers have been invalid, and their queries asked again

fields.name: lastAcceptedAnswerAt
fields.description: When an answer was last accepted

fields.name: numAccounts
fields.description: How many accounts the current target holds, once a peer has said

fields.name: accountsSettled
fields.description: How many of the current target's accounts the ledger is known to hold, whether received or already present. A sync whose ledger already matched its target can finish before any are counted, so a synced ledger should be read as complete.

fields.name: accountsReceived
fields.description: How many accounts peers have sent, over all targets

LedgerSync.description: The most recent sync of a ledger from peers

fields.name: target
fields.description: The root the sync is reaching

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the sync is still running

fields.name: progress
fields.description: For a sync that has ended, its progress when it ended

BootstrapStatus.description: What a node is doing to reach the network's chain

fields.name: bootstrapStartedAt
fields.description: When the current or most recent bootstrap started

fields.name: bootstrapAttempts
fields.description: How many attempts the current or most recent bootstrap has started

fields.name: lastAttemptFailure
fields.description: Why that bootstrap's last failed attempt failed

fields.name: ledgerSyncs
fields.description: The most recent sync of each ledger

TransactionPoolStatus.description: Occupancy of the transaction pool. When the pool is full, admitting a new command evicts the command with the lowest fee per weight unit, together with every later-nonce command from the same fee payer

fields.name: size
fields.description: Number of commands currently in the pool

fields.name: maxSize
fields.description: Number of commands the pool holds before it starts evicting commands

fields.name: minimumFeePerWeightUnit
fields.description: The lowest fee per weight unit of any command in the pool, in nanomina, as a decimal integer or a fraction 'n/d'. Null if the pool is empty. Once the pool is full, a new command must pay strictly more than this to be admitted. Payments and stake delegations have weight 1

ScanStateTree.description: Free space and outstanding snark work in one tree of the scan state

fields.name: availableSpace
fields.description: Number of transaction slots still free in this tree

fields.name: baseJobsTodo
fields.description: Number of base jobs in this tree that are yet to be done

fields.name: mergeJobsTodo
fields.description: Number of merge jobs in this tree that are yet to be done

ScanState.description: Status of the scan state as of a block

fields.name: stateHash
fields.description: State hash of the block whose scan state this is

fields.name: trees
fields.description: Status of each tree in the scan state, oldest first

BootstrapPhase.description: The step a node is in on its way to reaching the network's chain

enumValues.name: WAITING_FOR_GENESIS
enumValues.description: The chain has not started yet

enumValues.name: WAITING_FOR_PEERS
enumValues.description: Connecting to enough peers to begin

enumValues.name: FETCHING_BEST_TIP
enumValues.description: Asking peers for their best tip, while loading the transition frontier from disk

enumValues.name: SYNCING_ROOT_LEDGER
enumValues.description: Bootstrap: syncing the root's snarked ledger

enumValues.name: DOWNLOADING_SCAN_STATE
enumValues.description: Bootstrap: downloading the root's scan state and pending coinbases

enumValues.name: BUILDING_STAGED_LEDGER
enumValues.description: Bootstrap: building the root's staged ledger, which checks the scan state against the snarked ledger

enumValues.name: SYNCING_EPOCH_LEDGERS
enumValues.description: Syncing the staking and next epoch ledgers

enumValues.name: LOADING_FRONTIER
enumValues.description: Bootstrap: loading a transition frontier at the new root

SyncedLedger.description: A ledger that a node syncs from its peers

enumValues.name: ROOT_SNARKED
enumValues.description: The snarked ledger at the root of the transition frontier

fields.name: transactionPoolStatus
fields.description: Occupancy of this daemon's transaction pool, and the fee a new command must beat once the pool is full. Cheap enough to poll before each submission, as a back-pressure signal

fields.name: bootstrapStatus
fields.description: What the node is doing to reach the network's chain: its step of initialisation or bootstrap, and its ledger syncs

fields.name: scanState
fields.description: Free space and outstanding snark work in each tree of the scan state as of the given block, or of the best tip if no block is given. Returns an error if the block is not in the transition frontier or if the system is bootstrapping.

args.name: stateHash
args.description: The state hash of the desired block

fields.name: archiveVersionedPrecomputedBlock
fields.description: Send a precomputed block of any version the archive reads to the archive, which reads it by the rules of its own version. The block is forwarded as given.

args.name: block
args.description: Block encoded in precomputed block format, with its version

VersionedPrecomputedBlock.description: Block encoded in precomputed block format, of any version the archive reads
